EPA GHG repeal, H-1B curbs

I'll systematically scan the listed official sources for developments from September 5–19, 2026 and map any market-relevant items to your sector checklist.Pulling agency-specific items from the last two weeks so the sector map is complete.*1. Executive Summary*

The most market-relevant U.S. policy moves in the September 5–19, 2026 window were labor and energy regulation, not new statutes. On September 18 the White House extended the $100,000 H-1B entry fee and ordered agencies to weigh recent or planned U.S. layoffs when reviewing petitions—*increased friction* for Technology & Semiconductors (AI infrastructure hiring).
